title: Compass — Task Management System Built on Subtraction
summary: Compass is a task management system built on subtraction, not addition. Instead of showing everything forever, it uses dated pages, status-driven visibility, and a unified Today surface so the right work appears at the right time.

core_concepts.pages: Tasks live on the dated page where they were created. The current page stays at the front while old pages recede naturally instead of crowding the present.
core_concepts.auto_death: Older entries stop demanding attention without being deleted. Any task can be pulled forward to the current page when it deserves renewed attention.

status_model.ACTIVE: Working now or intending to work on it now.
status_model.WAITING: Hidden from the main view until the follow-up date arrives.
status_model.SCHEDULED: Quiet until its scheduled day arrives.
status_model.COMPLETE: Archived and accessible, but no longer in working views.
status_model.IDEA: Preserved without competing with current commitments.

core_concepts.today_surface: A unified view combining due/overdue tasks, tasks planned for today, waiting tasks whose follow-up date has arrived, and scheduled tasks whose day has arrived.
core_concepts.planning_module: Guides unclear tasks through the Natural Planning Model: purpose, vision of success, brainstorm, organize, next action.
core_concepts.compass_page: Holds a single Why statement and a set of Goals that orient the work beneath them.
core_concepts.priority_matrix: Helps make trade-offs explicit between competing tasks, with personal and business scoring models.

supporting_features: Finance module (net worth view: assets, debts, trajectory)
author: David Holt
